result: {"ratings": {"Sofia": {"rating": 5, "why": "Sofia finished the bottom curve early, kept inspecting the crossing and loop, stayed clear of Hana's corner to avoid bumps, and worked on the notch, so the fish body and tails ended up connected and lit."}, "Hana": {"rating": 4, "why": "Hana led well by choosing a clear fish, sketching it and assigning strokes, and she worked hard on the crossing and relaid the lower tail, but the loop at the tail never caught despite many attempts and she took on a lot of the fiddly fixes herself."}, "Jack": {"rating": 3, "why": "Jack laid his lower tail and stood a few dominoes back up, then kept clear of other people's work and stayed hands-off, but his tail was the one that didn't catch at first and most of its repair was done by Hana."}}}
